kinds.d: Fixed-wiring cable for mains circuits, including steel-wire armoured cable for burial or exposed runs.
Flexible mains cord for connecting appliances and fittings.
Tube or lidded surface channel through which cables are run and hidden.
Enclosure in which mains cables are joined.
Clip that fixes a cable to a wall or surface.
Plastic or metal strap with a ratchet that bundles or fixes cables.

notes: Armoured cable (k124) merged into Cable; conduit (k127) and trunking (k128) merged. Maker-less twin-and-earth model became a type. Nothing dropped.
